---
title: "Research"
---

My research focuses on analytical and strategic problems in platform operations, service operations, supply chains, pricing, logistics, and technology-enabled markets.

## Research Interests

- Operations and supply chain management
- Platform and service operations
- Revenue management and pricing
- Economic modeling
- Mechanism design
- Game theory
- Sharing-economy and two-sided platforms
- Artificial intelligence in operations
